text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle with attached first-person plural speaker, fusing assertion and identified agency
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) opens the ayah by fusing certainty with the identified divine speaker before the supported parties or time frames appear. Its speaker element then matches the support verb, so agency is fixed from the first word, and the repeated n/nā sound links speaker, support, and messenger object. The boundary from the failed appeal in 40:50 turns into a first-person promise rather than another report about defeat.

topics.headline: speaker-certainty fused at the opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears certainty and divine agency arrive together before the promise is unpacked.
topics.reason: The particle and attached pronoun jointly open the assertion and match the later first-person support verb.

topics.headline: initial assertion scopes over both arenas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present life and witness-day both remain inside the same opening assurance.
topics.reason: The opening assertion precedes the objects and both time frames, so the later witness scene is not detached from the promise.

topics.headline: boundary reset from 40:50
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the move from futile appeal in 40:50 into a direct first-person promise.
topics.reason: The boundary rows tie the opening declaration to the shift after 40:50; local syntax supports a new declarative frame.

topics.headline: nasal echo links speaker and support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the speaker, support verb, and messenger object bound by repeated nasal sound.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally anchored in repeated onset and suffix sounds across nearby forms.

words.gloss_range: prefixed emphatic lām that binds assurance directly to the following imperfect predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is small but load-bearing: it fastens assurance to the following imperfect support verb. The promise is therefore not presented as bare futurity or hopeful prediction; the particle makes doubt the target before the recipients are named, with an oath-answer potential that makes the predicate sound sworn-assured. Its short onset also makes the entry into support feel firm and compressed.

topics.headline: emphatic lām fixes assured action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support verb is asserted against doubt, not merely projected into the future.
topics.reason: The prefixed particle is attached to the imperfect predicate and is identified by the bundle as emphatic.

topics.headline: oath-answer force remains audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the promise as sworn-assured rather than ordinary emphasis alone.
topics.reason: The row preserves the oath-answer potential while local grammar keeps the particle as predicate emphasis.

topics.headline: double emphasis precedes recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees certainty placed before the supported parties are even named.
topics.reason: The opening particle and this lām form a stacked assertion before the object chain.

topics.headline: brief consonantal entry into support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a clipped onset that gives the promise a compact firmness.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally tied to the prefixed particle immediately before the support verb.

words.gloss_range: assured first-person plural imperfect support, governing the messengers and believers across both time frames
words.root_gloss_range: help, support, defense, victory, and vindication; the local Form I imperfect selects direct divine support whose public edge is sharpened by the witness scene
words.prose: {{ar:نَنصُرُ}} ({{tr:nananṣuru}}) is the structural spine of the ayah. With {{ar:ن ص ر}} ({{tr:n-ṣ-r}}), aid is direct and assured, but the closing witness scene turns aid toward public vindication as well as rescue. The imperfect and first-person plural let one divine predicate govern messengers, believers, present life, and the witness-day without splitting the promise, so support answers the lost calling of unbelief in 40:50 and gathers mission with belief under one outcome.

topics.headline: assured imperfect with divine speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one divine agent carry assured support across time rather than a closed past rescue.
topics.reason: The verb is first-person plural imperfect and is governed by the preceding emphatic particle.

topics.headline: aid widens into public vindication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that support includes help and defense but lands as public vindication when witnesses appear.
topics.reason: The lexical rows preserve the aid-victory range, and the local final witness noun licenses the evidentiary edge.

topics.headline: support gathers mission and belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees support answer both rejected unbelief in 40:50 and the mission-belief pairing inside the ayah.
topics.reason: The local objects are messengers and believers, while the cited comparison at 3:160 supports divine aid as protection against overpowering.

topics.headline: one predicate spans objects and arenas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one verb governs two recipient groups and two temporal frames.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb two objects and both the life phrase and day phrase as dependent frames.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural messengers as the first direct object of support, with mission and sender-relation both active
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatching, commissioning, and message-bearing; the local plural with possessive suffix selects authorized envoys rather than generic couriers
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلَنَا}} ({{tr:rusulanā}}) receives the support as the first direct object, while the attached speaker suffix makes the object a possessed mission rather than isolated heroic persons. The field of {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) keeps sending, commission, and message-bearing in view, and the plural gathers a class of missions across prophetic history. The boundary with 40:50 reverses rejected messengers into divinely owned envoys, and the later believers join them without erasing their messenger-first place; the syncopated reading tightens pacing without changing that referent.

topics.headline: supported object is possessed mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messengers as both recipients of support and envoys belonging to the speaker.
topics.reason: The noun is the first direct object and carries the attached first-person plural possessive suffix.

topics.headline: envoy sense carries mission and message
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that supporting messengers also protects the commissioned communication they bear.
topics.reason: The local possessive suffix and support verb select authorized envoys; the cited 57:25 comparison keeps proof-bearing mission in view.

topics.headline: messenger-first order expands to believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees believers included in the same support while the messenger-first order remains meaningful.
topics.reason: The following conjunction links the relative group to this object slot without erasing the first object's priority.

topics.headline: messenger root reverses 40:50
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from messengers rejected in 40:50 to messengers claimed and supported by God in 40:51.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly tie the messenger root across 40:50 and 40:51, and the changed possessive relation is locally visible.

topics.headline: broken plural gathers many missions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a class of messengers across prophetic history, not one isolated envoy.
topics.reason: The broken plural is the local form and is the direct object under the support verb.

topics.headline: variant tightens rhythm, not referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational tightening that affects pacing while the supported mission remains the same.
topics.reason: The accepted variant evidence changes internal vowel weight but not root, plurality, possessive suffix, or object role.

words.gloss_range: conjunction that expands the object set from messengers to the believing relative group
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) widens the object set while keeping the syntax under the same support verb. It adds the believing relative group to the messengers, but it also keeps the two groups distinct: office-bearers first, responders next. The conjunction is therefore a hinge of shared outcome, not a loose appendage.

topics.headline: conjunction joins believers to same verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees believers as recipients of the same promised support, not secondary beneficiaries.
topics.reason: The conjunction attaches the relative phrase to the messenger object under the support verb.

topics.headline: hinge from office-bearers to responders
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah widen from commissioned envoys to the community defined by faith.
topics.reason: The conjunction's position between the messenger object and relative phrase creates the widening movement.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun that makes the second supported group a class defined by its following clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the second supported object into a defined class before the defining action is complete. The word is incomplete until its following clause arrives, so identity is delayed and then anchored in belief. The result is not an indefinite group but those characterized by the clause that follows.

topics.headline: relative phrase inherits object role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the relative group inside the object chain, not as a loose description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the relative pronoun with the messenger object under the support verb.

topics.headline: identity waits for the belief clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the supported class is formed by a clause of belief, not by tribe or status.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun requires its following clause, and the masculine plural form packages a human class before that criterion arrives.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect belief completing the relative clause and defining the supported community by enacted trust
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, safety, faith, and fidelity; the local Form IV selects believing and trusting, not merely being safe or requesting protection
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) closes the relative phrase by making belief the completed criterion of the second supported group. The root {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) brings trust, security, and fidelity into the scene, while the local Form IV keeps the sense on responsive belief rather than merely being safe or seeking protection. The contrast with the unbelieving outcome in 40:50 makes faith a public alignment under support.

topics.headline: perfect verb completes supported identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief as the completed criterion that closes the relative group.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb agrees with the relative pronoun and completes the relative clause.

topics.headline: faith carries trust and vulnerability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is trust-shaped alignment answered by divine support.
topics.reason: The objectless Form IV verb leaves the trust relation open while the support verb supplies protection from the divine side.

topics.headline: requestive security is only a contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the difference between believers defined by trust and a request-form that would foreground seeking protection.
topics.reason: The requestive derivative is valid lexical contrast, but the local surface is Form IV belief, not a request for security.

topics.headline: belief receives the opposite outcome from 40:50
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary distribute unbelief and belief into loss in 40:50 and support in 40:51.
topics.reason: The local believer object contrasts with the prior unbeliever outcome, while 2:285 supports messenger-believer alignment as a recognized pairing.

words.gloss_range: preposition that makes the life phrase a governed arena where support is manifested
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the following life phrase an arena containing the manifestation of support. The promise is not only about where people happen to be; it is placed inside the domain of lived history. Because this first frame remains dependent on the same verb, the later witness-day can join it rather than replace it, while the long vowel eases the recitation into that first arena.

topics.headline: preposition makes life a support arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices support manifesting within a lived domain rather than being stated as an abstract guarantee only.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the life phrase and attaches it to the support verb as a domain frame.

topics.headline: first arena prepares a matched second frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees present life as the first frame of a promise that will continue into witness-day.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase remains dependent on the same predicate and leaves room for the coordinated day-frame.

topics.headline: long vowel carries the first frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the preposition ease the recitation into the life arena.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally anchored in the short preposition before the life noun.

words.gloss_range: definite governed life-domain, modified by the near-life adjective rather than acting as an object of support
words.root_gloss_range: life, vitality, living condition, and embodied existence; the local verbal noun forms a domain of living, not an act of giving life
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) names life as the governed sphere of support, not as a supported object. The root {{ar:ح ي ي}} ({{tr:ḥ-y-y}}) gives the phrase real lived vitality, but the local noun makes that vitality a domain rather than an act of creating life. Its pairing with the near-life modifier and the later witness-day means present history matters without becoming the final verdict; the same-surah near-life return from 40:39 and the true-life contrast in 29:64 keep that horizon bounded.

topics.headline: life is governed sphere and modified head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees life framing the action while the following adjective narrows which life is meant.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and is the head modified by the near-life adjective.

topics.headline: vitality becomes a domain, not revival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present life is real embodied vitality, while the local grammar keeps support inside life rather than making the word a life-giving verb.
topics.reason: The lexical field survives as vitality pressure, but the local form is a governed verbal noun domain, not a causative revival form.

topics.headline: present life precedes final testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees present history affirmed as a real arena while 29:64, 40:39, and the local witness-day keep it from becoming final.
topics.reason: The local phrase is paired with the witness-day, and the cited 29:64 and 40:39 rows preserve the near-life contrast and same-surah return.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine modifier narrowing life to the nearer and lower arena before the witness-day horizon arrives
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, approach, accessibility, and lower rank; the local adjective marks present life as real and proximate but not final
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) qualifies life as the nearer and lower arena. The root {{ar:د ن و}} ({{tr:d-n-w}}) makes present life accessible and proximate, but also limited in rank. By sealing the first arena this way, the word prepares the need for the second horizon where witnesses stand; the phrase also carries a familiar near-life register rather than a one-off description.

topics.headline: adjective locks onto life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that near-worldliness modifies life rather than opening a separate arena.
topics.reason: Agreement and definiteness make the word an adjective dependent on the life noun.

topics.headline: nearness and lowness qualify the first arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears present life as close and accessible, but also lower on the value scale.
topics.reason: The lexical rows support both nearness and lowness, and the elative adjective shape preserves comparison.

topics.headline: near life invites the second horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why present support is real but incomplete until the witness-day horizon arrives.
topics.reason: The rows tie the local near-life phrase to a corrected value scale, with 87:16-17 giving a concrete contrast for overvalued near life.

topics.headline: familiar near-life formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a familiar evaluative register, not a one-off description.
topics.reason: Distributional and same-surah rows keep the established near-life register in view while local syntax keeps it adjectival.

words.gloss_range: conjunction that joins the witness-day frame to the same support promise without starting a new main verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the promise from the near-life domain into a second temporal frame. It coordinates unlike constructions under one verb: a prepositional life arena and an accusative day-frame. The shift is additive and transitional at once, so the witness scene is not detached from the earlier promise and the failed appeal in 40:50 moves toward evidentiary completion.

topics.headline: conjunction coordinates the witness-day frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same support promise span present life and witness-day without a second main verb.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the accusative day-frame to the preceding life-domain under one predicate.

topics.headline: pivot from domain to witness event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the movement from a near-life label into an evidentiary completion that answers the failed appeal in 40:50.
topics.reason: The boundary row contrasts the futile appeal in 40:50 with the joined witness-day scene, while local syntax supplies the pivot.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal frame whose identity is completed by the standing of witnesses
words.root_gloss_range: day, time, occasion, and decisive event-time; the local accusative adverb selects a witness-defined accountability moment rather than neutral duration
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) opens an accusative time frame whose meaning waits for the clause that follows. The root {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) can name a day or decisive occasion; here the standing of witnesses fills it as accountability-time. The result is a second arena where support becomes finally demonstrable, not just a calendar point after present life.

topics.headline: day-frame waits for its clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day is an adverbial frame completed by what happens in it, not another object of support.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative temporal adverb and leans on the following witness-standing clause for definition.

topics.headline: ordinary day becomes witness-defined accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears time become an evidentiary occasion, sharpened by witness-standing rather than measured by duration.
topics.reason: The local witness clause selects event-time and accountability force, while 1:4 provides a concrete day-of-recompense comparison.

topics.headline: second frame completes staged vindication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees support neither postponed entirely nor confined to visible history.
topics.reason: The day-frame is coordinated with the life-domain and forms a compact scene with time, action, and subject.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect standing that completes the day-frame and activates the witness subject
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, becoming established, and operative uprightness; the local verb makes testimony stand into effect, not merely describes posture
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُومُ}} ({{tr:yaqūmu}}) supplies the action that turns the day into a scene. The root {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) lets standing become establishment, so witness testimony becomes operative rather than merely visible. The masculine singular profile treats the later witnesses as an operative collective body; the verb comes before its subject, delaying who stands and focusing first on activation, while variant agreement affects profile rather than the evidentiary event.

topics.headline: verb completes the day-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb turn the day from a time word into an unfolding scene.
topics.reason: The verb is the predicate inside the temporal clause opened by the preceding day-frame.

topics.headline: agreement profile treats witnesses as a body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnesses can be heard as an operative collective body, while the variant affects agreement profile rather than the event.
topics.reason: The canonical masculine singular verb precedes the plural subject; the variant evidence shifts agreement profile but does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: standing becomes operative proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that standing activates testimony and establishes proof, not just posture.
topics.reason: The root field supports standing and establishment, and the local subject is the witnesses.

topics.headline: verb before subject delays who stands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears activation, then learns that the actors are witnesses, shifting the scene from defendants to evidence.
topics.reason: The local order puts the verb before its subject; 83:6 and 40:46 provide concrete standing-scene contrasts.

words.gloss_range: definite plural witness-bearers as the delayed subject that closes the ayah on public evidence
words.root_gloss_range: presence, seeing, witnessing, and testimony; the local plural noun selects active evidence-bearers rather than abstract testimony alone
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ}} ({{tr:al-ashhādu}}) resolves the delayed subject and closes the ayah on evidence-bearers. The root {{ar:ش ه د}} ({{tr:sh-h-d}}) joins presence, seeing, and testimony, so support lands as public attestation. The definite plural makes the proof a recognizable witness-body, and the final placement rereads the opening support as vindication before witnesses; after the failed appeal in 40:50, public testimony replaces another round of dialogue.

topics.headline: final subject closes the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits until the final word to learn that witnesses define the day.
topics.reason: The plural definite noun is the nominative subject after the singular verb, closing the temporal clause.

topics.headline: witness-bearers convert presence into proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees testimony embodied in active evidence-bearers rather than abstract knowledge.
topics.reason: The lexical field joins presence, seeing, and testimony, and the local plural noun names agents who stand.

topics.headline: closing witnesses reread support as vindication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening support is interpreted at the end as public attestation.
topics.reason: The support verb and final witness noun frame the ayah, making the intervening objects and arenas material for vindication.

topics.headline: witness scene answers false claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failed appeal in 40:50 answered by public testimony rather than another dialogue.
topics.reason: The cited 11:18 witness scene and the local boundary row preserve exposure of false claims, while the sound row reinforces firm closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic promise in نَنصُرُ spans فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا and the day on which ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ stand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aid that also makes its recipient manifest is distributed across a near present arena and a severe future event. The standing of knowledgeable witnesses gives that aid a public and evidentiary endpoint, not merely an inward consolatory one.

activation_trace.role: Literal aid joined to making the aided side manifest supplies the public-vindication mechanism.
The nearer or present world supplies the first temporal arena rather than a claim about finality.
A day understood as a grave event gives the second arena the force of a decisive occurrence.
Resurrection-standing places the manifestation within the rising of creation for judgment.
Knowledgeable declaration and disclosure make the standing witnesses evidentiary agents.

changed_reading.before: A general promise that God gives victory to messengers and believers in this world and the next.
changed_reading.after: A two-horizon promise of public vindication: aid becomes manifest in the near life and becomes decisively attestable when informed witnesses stand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked plurals رُسُلَنَا, ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا, and ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ allow support to run through successive bearers rather than terminate in one person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive messengers carry a claim, trusting believers receive and confirm it, and later witnesses stand in an evidentiary role. Support can therefore preserve a transmissible mission through replacement and relay, without requiring every individual bearer to remain present.

activation_trace.role: Aid and manifestation supply what maintains the mission across its bearers.
Successive groups supply a relay image for the plural messengers.
Heart-settling confirmation makes believers receivers and affirmers of the carried claim.
Standing in another's place supplies the possibility that later agents carry an earlier claim forward.
Disclosure by witnesses is the relay's final public function.

changed_reading.before: Support chiefly means preserving or empowering each messenger as an individual.
changed_reading.after: Support may also preserve the message through successive messengers, confirming believers, and witnesses who can stand for what earlier bearers carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believer inside Pharaoh's household moves from concealment to evidence-bearing speech, entrusts his affair, and is then guarded while harm encloses the hostile side. This narrates worldly support as the conversion of hidden faith into protected public testimony and reversed danger.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes its recipient manifest anchors the believer's protected emergence into public speech.
The tongue as witness anchors the public-speaking mechanism back in the focus ayah.
Literal hiding supplies the suppressed starting state of the believer's testimony.
Uttered speech supplies the transition from concealed conviction to a public claim.
Disclosure through speech or sign gives the believer's intervention evidentiary content.
Entrusting the affair to another marks the speaker's surrender of control immediately before protection.
Direct warding of harm supplies the concrete worldly-protection result.
Harm descending and enclosing the hostile household supplies the reversal side of vindication.

structural_cues: 40:28 identifies the speaker as a believer from Pharaoh's household who had concealed his faith.
40:44-45 places entrusting the affair immediately before divine protection and the enclosing punishment of Pharaoh's people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, speech with clear evidence, entrusting, warding, and enclosing harm; I infer the arrow concealed believer to public witness to protected speaker and reversed danger. A live alternative is that 40:45 illustrates one rescue without defining every instance of worldly support.

changed_reading.before: Worldly support is an external victory bestowed on an already visible believing side.
changed_reading.after: Worldly support can make a concealed believer's truthful voice stand inside hostile power, protect that speaker, and turn the planned harm back onto its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Hour stands, parties dispute and shift responsibility, judgment has already been made between the servants, messengers had brought clear disclosures, and excuses no longer benefit. The witnesses in 40:51 therefore stand within an operative adjudication rather than as ceremonial spectators.

activation_trace.role: Knowledgeable declaration anchors the witnesses as contributors to a judgment.
The rising of the Hour identifies the standing as eschatological and procedurally decisive.
A prevailing proof within dispute supplies the contested argumentative setting.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative action that resolves the dispute.
Clear disclosure by speech or sign supplies the messengers' evidentiary record.
The explicit loss of benefit marks the point at which a defensive claim can no longer alter the outcome.
The excuse supplies the rejected defense against which standing testimony has force.

structural_cues: 40:46-52 forms an uninterrupted sequence from the standing of the Hour through dispute, judgment, recalled messenger evidence, and failed excuse.
40:47-48 specifically blocks the followers' attempt to transfer responsibility to their former leaders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies eschatological standing, litigation, judgment, clear disclosures, and a failed excuse; I infer a courtroom-like causal sequence in which testimony makes vindication operative. A live alternative is a dramatic confrontation without a formally staged procedure.

changed_reading.before: The witnesses merely appear on the resurrection day as part of its scene.
changed_reading.after: Their standing belongs to an adjudicative process: messenger evidence is recalled, blame transfer fails, excuses lose force, and promised support becomes a judgment in favor of truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opponents try to seize messengers and make truth lose its footing; after Joseph's death they declare that no later messenger will be sent. Yet guidance becomes inherited writing and reminder, while messenger reports continue in both narrated and unnarrated chains. Support thus prevents the mission's erasure even when an individual bearer dies.

activation_trace.role: Successive bearers anchor support in a relay rather than one messenger's lifespan.
Capture and seizure occur on both sides of the verse, supplying attempted suppression and its reversal.
The collapse of an argument supplies the opponents' intended cancellation of truth.
Making truth manifest identifies what the attempted cancellation fails to erase.
A messenger's death supplies the apparent break on which the denial of future sending depends.
Dispatching a sent agent supplies the continuation that the doubters deny.
Sending and release keep the disputed possibility of a later messenger explicit.
Inherited knowledge or writing supplies transmission beyond the original recipient.
Ordered writing supplies a durable material carrier for the mission.
A reminder reactivates the inherited record for later recipients.
Repeated sending and plural messengers supply the long succession that defeats the claim of termination.
Sequentially carrying reports distinguishes narrated bearers from a larger unnarrated succession.

structural_cues: 40:34 places the claim that no messenger would be sent after Joseph directly after his death.
40:53-54 couples inherited book with guidance and reminder, while 40:78 explicitly contrasts narrated and unnarrated messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted capture and cancellation, messenger death, denied future dispatch, inherited writing, reminder, and selective narration; I infer the arrow divine support to survival of the mission through renewed sending and durable record. A live alternative is that transmission is an effect of support while the focus promise primarily concerns personal aid.

changed_reading.before: Supporting messengers means preventing their defeat or death.
changed_reading.after: Support also defeats erasure: a messenger may die, yet the claim is resent, inherited, remembered, narrated, and made available for later witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee must hold steady because he may either see part of the promised outcome or have his life taken before it; all are then returned. A messenger also cannot produce a sign independently, and decisive judgment waits for the divine command. Certainty of support is therefore separated from personal control of its timing and display.

activation_trace.role: The emphatic aid promise remains certain while context changes who must see its full manifestation.
Holding the self from collapse supplies the posture required during an unresolved timetable.
A promise that opens hope supplies certainty without fixing which outcome the addressee will witness.
Taking the soul in full supplies the live possibility that death precedes visible completion.
Return restores every party to the arena in which the unresolved outcome is completed.
Permission conditions a messenger's production of signs and blocks personal control of manifestation.
Decisive judgment supplies the eventual closure when the command arrives.
Truth fixed to reality identifies the standard by which delayed closure occurs.

structural_cues: The either-or construction in 40:77 explicitly permits death before the addressee sees some of what is promised.
40:78 moves from permission-limited signs to judgment only when God's command arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, a true promise, partial seeing or death, return, permission, and delayed judgment; I infer the arrow certain support does not entail that each messenger sees every promised outcome during life. The live alternative retained by the first side of 40:77 is personal sight of some worldly outcome.

changed_reading.before: The promise guarantees that each supported messenger will personally see the full worldly victory.
changed_reading.after: The promise guarantees that the cause is upheld across worldly transmission and final judgment, while an individual messenger may see only part of the outcome or die before its full display.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remaining traces invite inspection, inherited writing becomes guidance and reminder, displayed signs confront denial, and messengers bring clear disclosures. These form a preserved evidence chain that can stand behind personal witnesses, so the support of 40:51 includes keeping truth inspectable.

activation_trace.role: A sign that indicates a time or condition anchors testimony in evidence-bearing marks as well as speakers.
A remaining mark that indicates what was supplies the historical layer of the evidence chain.
Transmission of knowledge or writing as inheritance preserves evidence across generations.
Ordered letters and written content give the inherited evidence a durable form.
A reminder makes preserved evidence cognitively active for later readers.
Visible signs supply present evidence placed before those being addressed.
Denial against recognition supplies the contested response that preserved signs answer.
Appearance and disclosure supply the clarity of the messengers' evidence.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the command to travel, inspect outcomes, and attend to آثار in the earth.
40:53-54 links inherited book to guidance and reminder; 40:81-83 then joins displayed signs, denial, messengers, and clear proofs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surviving traces, inherited writing, reminder, displayed signs, denial, and clear proofs; I infer the arrow preservation of evidence to testimony that can later stand. A live alternative is that ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ denotes persons only, with artifacts merely supporting their testimony.

changed_reading.before: The witnesses are isolated persons who supply new testimony on the final day.
changed_reading.after: The witnesses stand with a long evidence chain already preserved in traces, writing, memory, and displayed signs; divine support includes preventing that record from disappearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descending sky-provision is presented as a sign; night and day make life inhabitable and visible; earth is made a stable base with good provision and growing blessing. Read through the rain-relief, earth-life, and sustaining-standing branches in the focus, support in the near life can include the material ecology that enables a believing community to remain standing.

activation_trace.role: Rain and relief supply the focus-side material image of aid arriving to revive a land or people.
Earth living through rain and growth turns worldly life into a revivification mechanism.
Sustenance and structural support identify what lets a life or community stand.
An indicative sign makes the sustained created order evidentiary rather than merely useful.
Delivery from above supplies the directional arrival of the provisioning aid.
Rain descending as provision directly couples sustenance to the sky-sign context.
Habitable settlement supplies the daily environmental condition for sustained life.
Fixity and stability make the earth a base on which life can persist.
Stable, growing good supplies the productive result of the provisioning system.

structural_cues: 40:13 places displayed signs and provision descending from the sky in one sentence.
40:61-65 groups daily rhythm, visible day, stable earth, good provision, blessing, and divine life within one created order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descending provision, habitation, stable earth, and growing good; the focus supplies rain-relief, earth-life, sustaining-standing, and sign branches. I infer the arrow provisioning to life or community standing to visible witness. A live alternative is that these verses display general beneficence without specifying the meaning of نَنصُرُ in 40:51.

changed_reading.before: Support in worldly life is only a discrete intervention against an enemy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, support also names the provisioning infrastructure by which life and a trusting community can keep standing as a visible sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links throne-bearing, message-bearing, protective covering, and terrestrial transport across distant domains. It remains anchored in رُسُلَنَا as carriers of speech and in the supported believers, with repeated branch-backed حمل around them. Render it only as a secondary carrying analogy, not as an etymology of نصر or a claim that the same agents literally carry believers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رُسُلَنَا names message-carriers among the recipients of نَنصُرُ, while ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا are the beneficiaries around whom the carrying pattern gathers.

activation_trace.role: A messenger as bearer of carried speech provides the focus-side carrying anchor.
Bearing a visible load supplies an upper-scale carrying structure around prayers for believers.
Covering that protects gives the carriers' prayers a protective function toward believers.
A carrying vehicle or mount supplies the lower-scale transport that brings people toward their needs.
Tangible benefit makes terrestrial carrying an enabling aid rather than a decorative parallel.

changed_reading.before: Divine support is imagined only as force applied against an opponent.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, support appears as a cross-scale carrying architecture: messages are carried, protective prayer surrounds believers, and created conveyances carry people toward need.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets rain-revived growth echo the standing witnesses. It remains visibly anchored in the focus branches for rain-relief, earth-life, bodily or vegetative standing, and indicative signs, while 40:13 supplies descending rain-provision as a shown sign. Downstream prose must present it as a material analogy and must not claim that ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ grammatically means vegetation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch cluster around نَنصُرُ, ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ, يَقُومُ, and ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ permits an image in which aid revives life that rises into visible evidence.

activation_trace.role: Watercourses arriving from afar supply a channel by which aid reaches a gathered place.
Rain-revived earth and fresh growth supply the life that responds to aid.
Bodily standing, including plants standing on their roots, supplies the rising visible form.
An indicative mark lets the risen life function analogically as evidence of the aid it received.
Delivery from above supplies the arrival movement of the reviving provision.
Rain descending as provision makes the ecological image contextually active rather than focus-branch play alone.

changed_reading.before: The standing witnesses are only a juridical crowd unrelated to worldly material life.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, divinely aided life rises like rain-revived growth and becomes a material sign anticipating the witnesses' public standing.

strongest_changes: The protected believer of Pharaoh's household turns worldly support into a sequence of concealed faith, public evidence-bearing speech, protection, and reversal of harm.
The post-focus sequence makes witness-standing adjudicative: dispute and blame transfer fail before messenger evidence, judgment, and the collapse of excuses.
Messenger death and uncertain personal timing no longer negate support because renewed sending, inherited writing, reminder, traces, and final judgment preserve and vindicate the mission.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context places 40:51 after a protected believer's counter-speech and before failed eschatological defenses, then extends its promise through inherited records, historical traces, and the possibility that a messenger dies before seeing the full outcome. This made support look like protected testimony, anti-erasure transmission, and eventual adjudicative manifestation, while retaining a contained ecological branch activation.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between bodily rescue and preservation of the mission remains plural; the packet supports both and does not force one to replace the other.
The witnesses may be persons exclusively, with books, signs, and آثار only backing them; the broader evidence-chain reading should remain qualified.
The provisioning, revived-growth, and carrying readings are branch-backed structural analogies, not lexical replacements for نصر or ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Aid extends across two arenas and culminates in witnessed standing.** `ن ص ر/B001` gives aid that makes someone prevail; `ش ه د/B001` gives presence with witnessing. Worldly life and the day form the paired scope. I infer that testimony is itself a mode of victory, publicly vindicating what power suppressed; aid need not have one temporal form.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The next ayah specifies the witness-day’s asymmetry: public vindication for messengers coexists with excuses becoming useless for wrongdoers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Aid reaches completion as publicly witnessed vindication.** Lexically, `ن ص ر:B001` is "aid that makes someone prevail," `ش ه د:B001` is presence with witnessing, and `ق و م:B002` upright standing. Structurally, failed invocations dominate 40:47-50; this ayah answers with effective aid in the nearer life and on the day witnesses stand, while 40:52 specifies what their presence does to excuses. Witnesses give the aid a public evidentiary form. The packet supplies aid across two times and standing witnesses; I infer that testimony manifests the rightness of those aided, completing rather than merely repeating worldly help. Victory here includes recognized vindication before an assembled field.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:78 preserves messenger traces through selective recounting, and 40:82 preserves material traces in land; aid survives as narratable and inspectable witness beyond the event itself.

facets.statement: Bir başkasına, özellikle haksızlığa uğramış olana yardım ve destek sağlama çekirdeğidir.
Yardımın düşmana karşı üstünlük ve başarı sağlaması, çekirdeğin çatışma ortamındaki belirginleşmiş biçimidir.
Karşılıklı kullanımda birden çok tarafın birbirine yardım etmesi ve iş birliği yapması anlatılır.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurun kendisini, özellikle yeterli ve yararlı bir yağışı adlandırır. İlgili yapılarda yağmurun toprağı sulayıp yeşertmesi, toprağın yağmur alması ve insanların yağmurla sıkıntıdan kurtulması anlatılır.

facets.statement: Yağmurun adı ve özellikle eksiksiz, yeterli bir yağış oluşu bu dalın adlandırma çekirdeğidir.
Yağmurun ülkeyi veya toprağı sulaması ve bitki çıkarması, yararlı etkinin başlıca gerçekleşmesidir.
Toprağın yağmur almış duruma gelmesi, olayın etkilenen yer açısından kurulan biçimidir.
Bir topluluğun yağmura kavuşarak kuraklık veya susuzluktan kurtulması, etkinin insanlar açısından kurulan biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yağmur adını, yeterli yağışı, toprağın yağmur almasını ve yağmurun sulama, yeşertme ve insanları rahatlatma sonuçlarını aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan verme ve armağan anlamını, daha genel biçimde de iyi bir şeyi ulaştırma veya sunma düşüncesini bildirir. Verilen çerçeve bu iki yönü yardım ve yağmur dallarına taşırmadan doğru biçimde birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın armağan ve iyilik verme kapsamını korur; yağmur veya belirli bir yardım yapısı bu anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Birine armağan, yarar veya başka bir iyi şey vermek ve böylece iyiliği ona ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye armağan ya da yararlı bir şey verme anlamı dalın doğrudan çekirdeğidir.
Verilen şeyin maddi bir armağanla sınırlı kalmayıp genel olarak iyilik ulaştırması da kapsanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğrudan armağan verme anlamında birleşir ve bunu daha genel olarak birine iyi bir şey ulaştırma düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddi armağanı ve daha genel iyi bir şey ulaştırmayı birlikte kapsayan kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Verme eylemini, yararlanan kişiyi ve verilen şeyin iyi veya yararlı oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen iyi şeyin somut bir bağış veya armağan olarak düşünüldüğü bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Birine değerli veya yararlı bir şeyi karşılıksız verme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Somut armağan sayılmayan daha genel iyilik ulaştırma biçimlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen şeyin türü belirtilmediğinde ve yararlı sonuç öne çıkarıldığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.adds: Bir şey verme içermeyen koruma, destek ve birlikte çalışma biçimlerini de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün yardım ve üstünlük sağlama dalıyla karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Hristiyanlığı, bu dine girme ve birini bu dine sokma eylemlerini, bağlı kişi ile topluluğun adlarını ve adlandırmanın kökenine dair iki açıklamayı birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi temel din ve bağlılık alanını doğru kurar; köken açıklamaları anlamın kendisi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adın yardımcılar düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilmesi, bu dalı yardım anlamına dönüştürmez; din ve bağlılık çekirdeği korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, Hristiyanlık alanındaki din, bağlılık, dine girme ve dine sokma biçimlerini kapsar; adın kökenine ilişkin açıklamalar yalnızca ikincil bilgi olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hristiyanlığı, bu dine bağlı olmayı, bu dine girmeyi veya birini bu dine sokmayı ve bağlı kişi ya da topluluğu adlandıran anlam alanıdır. Adın kökeni için Tanrı'nın yardımcıları olma çağrısına ve bir yer adına bağlanan iki açıklama aktarılır; bunlar temel anlamı belirlemez.

facets.statement: Hristiyanlık ve bu dine bağlılık, dalın din ve kimlik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Bir kişinin Hristiyanlığı benimseyip bu dine girmesi, bağlılığın oluşma sürecidir.
Bir başkasını Hristiyan yapmak, sürecin dışarıdan bir etkileyenle kurulan ettirgen biçimidir.
Dine bağlı erkek, kadın ve topluluk için kullanılan adlar aynı kimlik alanını kişi ve grup düzeyinde kurar.
Adlandırmanın kökeni bir açıklamada Tanrı'nın yardımcıları olma çağrısına, diğerinde bir yer adına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam alanı Hristiyanlık, bu dine girme veya sokma ve bağlı kişileri adlandırmadır. Adın kökeni için Tanrı'nın yardımcıları düşüncesine ve bir yer adına dayanan iki farklı açıklama aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uzaktaki bir yerden gelip vadiye veya suyun toplandığı yere ulaşan yarıntı ve su yataklarını açıkça tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi bu yer biçimini yağmurun kendisinden ve genel su akışından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak bir başlangıçtan su toplanma yerine uzanan yatak veya yarıntı belirleyicidir; yalnız suyun akması yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kanıtlanan çoğul su yatağı adını esas alır ve incelemede tutulan iki olası tekil biçimi yalnız kendi sözlüksel satırlarında gösterir; çıplak köke genel su yolu anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Uzak bir yerden başlayıp vadiye veya suyun biriktiği yere ulaşan doğal yarıntı, dere kolu ya da su yatağıdır.

facets.statement: Su yatağı veya yarıntı uzaktaki bir yerden gelir ve vadiye ya da su toplanma yerine ulaşır.
Adlandırma, suyun aktığı yatak ile bu yatağı oluşturan doğal yarıntı görünümünü birlikte kapsayabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, uzaktan gelen suyu vadiye veya su toplanma yerine taşıyan doğal yatak ve yarıntıların sınırlı adlandırmasını temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sütü, özellikle bol ve sürekli gelen sütü kapsar; sürü, ileti veya genel bolluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Dalın somut çekirdeği hayvandan elde edilen süttür.
Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın süt maddesini ve özellikle belirtilen ardışık akış niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sütü, bolluğunu ve sürekli akışını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesi uzantısını doğrudan adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Maddenin kendisi kastedildiğinde en yalın doğal karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, birine veya bir şeye ısınıp yanında rahatça açılmayı kapsar; yavaş okuma veya genel gönderme anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, birine ya da bir şeye yönelmeyi belirten yapılarla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir yakınlık anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye veya şeye içten yönelip yabancılık duymamak; ona güvenerek yanında rahatlamak ve kendini çekinmeden açmaktır.

Bu güvenin görünür sonucu, karşısındakinin yanında rahat ve açık davranmaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklı haberleşme, yarışma eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte izleme biçimlerini kendi yapılara bağlı tutar; yalın köke genel arkadaşlık anlamı verilmez.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki taraf arasında karşılıklı gönderim veya birinin ötekini izlemesiyle kurulan eşgüdümdür.
Atışma veya başka bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran ve onunla birlikte ilerleyen eşlikçi kastedilebilir.
Şarkı veya işte bir öncekinin sesini ya da eylemini izleyerek sürdüren kişi kastedilebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kullanımda sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahatlığı, başka bir kullanımda ise bir şeyi içten ve isteyerek vermeyi gösterir. Çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak gönüllü veriş rahatlık çekirdeğinin bağımsız eş anlamlısı değil, belirli verme bağlamındaki uzantısı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen yapılarda rahatlık ve gönül hoşluğuyla vermeyi kapsar; genel süt, sürü veya bütün refah adlandırmalarına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sıkıntı-rahatlık karşıtlığını ve gönül hoşluğuyla verme kullanımını taşıyan belirtilmiş yapıya bağlıdır; yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.

Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haber veya sozun dogrulanmasi anlatildiginda en dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdik cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dini boyun egme ve davranisla baglanma tarafini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dini ve icten kabullenme baglamlarinda tasdikten daha genis sureci aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Tasdikle birlikte ic kabul ve baglanma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sade haber tasdiki icin fazla agir ve ozel kalir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vaat edilen seyin gercek ve guvenilir kilinmasi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Vaatle ilgili dogrulama tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tasdik ve dini kabullenme alanlarini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul talebi ve onu soyleme eylemi icin genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Dua baglamini, kabul istegini ve sabit soz niteligini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sozun dua icindeki anlamini eylemli bicimde cevirmek gerektiginde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Sabit soz ve onu soyleme eylemi olma tarafini eksiltir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duanin sonucuna katilma ve gerceklesmesini dileme baglaminda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul ve gerceklesme istegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ilahi muhataba yonelen talep kuvvetini ve sozu soyleme eylemini tam tasimaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylem adi olan kullanimda, yani bu sozu telaffuz etme anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sozu soyleme eylemini ve dua baglamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sozun tek basina anlamini ve ad yorumu yanini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ölümün karşıtı olan canlılık durumu etrafında kurar; canlı kalmayı, yaşamın farklı güç ve düzeylerini, yeniden canlandırmayı ve ölümün düşünülemediği sürekli var oluşu da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşam durumunu ve onu başlatma ya da sürdürme işlemini kapsar; yağmur, karşılama sözü, utanma ve başka özel türevler ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel yaşam ve canlı olma anlamlarıyla, canlı kalma, canlandırma ve özel türevlerde beliren kullanımlar birbirinden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Ölümün karşıtı olarak canlı olma ve canlı kalma durumudur; bir varlığı canlı kılma ya da yeniden canlandırma işlemini de kapsar. Bitkisel, duyusal ve düşünsel yaşam ile dünyadaki, sonraki ve ölmez var oluş bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın ölü olmayıp canlı bulunması ve yaşamını sürdürmesi temel anlamdır.
Canlı kılma veya ölümden sonra yeniden canlandırma, temel durumun ettirgen ve yenileyici uzantısıdır.
Bitkisel büyüme, duyum, düşünme, dünya yaşamı, sonraki yaşam ve ölmez var oluş, canlılığın kaynakta ayrılan özel düzeyleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm karşıtı canlılık çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu tanıklık ayrıca yaşamın güçlerini, sürekliliğini ve yeniden canlandırmayı bu çekirdeğin kapsamına alır.

concept_gloss.text: canlı olma, sürüp gitme ve canlandırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın durum, süreklilik ve canlı kılma işlemlerini birlikte anlatan en geniş doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ölüm karşıtı durumu, yaşamın sürmesini ve canlı kılma işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın ölmeden yaşamını sürdürdüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı olma ve yaşamı sürdürme durumunu doğal bir yüklemle verir.
error_profile.loses: Canlandırma işlemini ve yaşamın özel düzeylerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölmüş ya da sönmüş sayılan bir varlığın yeniden canlı duruma getirildiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Canlılığın yeniden kazandırılması işlemini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendiliğinden canlı olma ve yaşamı sürdürme durumlarını kapsamaz.
